## Verification Complete

I've independently reviewed the volunteer shifts tool and written a comprehensive release verdict to **REVIEW.md**.

**What I verified:**
- Reviewed product requirements (PRODUCT.md) against implementation
- Analyzed server architecture and routing (src/server.js)
- Examined data persistence layer (src/shifts.js)
- Confirmed frontend UI is missing entirely (public/index.html)
- Evaluated test coverage (test/shifts.test.js)
- Checked design consistency (design tokens vs. direction)

**Critical finding:** The application is non-functional—the entire frontend UI described in the walkthrough (sign-in form, shift list, assign buttons) is missing from public/index.html. Combined with unaddressed security issues (hardcoded session secret, no authentication validation) and data race conditions in concurrent shift assignment, this tool is **not ready for production use**.

The verdict document details all five critical/high-severity blockers and a path to remediation.
